messages:
mina.sales: Closed deal - HelioThera Inc. SOW signed. Requirements: private VPC, Okta SSO, audit logging, and per-route cost reports. Go-live target: 2026-06-15. They called out renewal sensitivity if onboarding misses first 30 days.

alexa.cs: I'll own the onboarding. Primary CS = alexa.cs. Need triage with eng/support this week to lock infra and compliance checks. @tom.support can you open the intake ticket and add HIPAA/GDPR tags if needed?

tom.support: Creating ticket now. What
re their environment details and contact list?
\lmina.sales: tenant: heliothera-prod, contacts: ops@heliothera.com (Ops), seclead@heliothera.com (Security). Data class: customer says "sensitive PII"  likely GDPR scope.

michael.eng: From eng: required capacity (peak RPS), avg tokens, preferred model size, and latency SLOs. Also confirm if they want Redwood-hosted model fallback.

alexa.cs: Customer prefers private VPC + hosted fallback. Peak ~15 RPS, avg tokens ~70, p95 latency target <450ms. Start with quantized 13B, evaluate for 70B later.

tom.support: Ticket HELIO-ONB-7111 created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/HELIO-ONB-7111. Tags: onboarding, vpc, gdpr, audit-logs. Assigned to eng-platform + eng-runtime + cs.

onboard-bot: New ticket HELIO-ONB-7111 logged by tom.support. SLA: 72h initial triage. Watchers recommended: natasha.sre, rachel.security.

michael.eng: Proposed plan: deploy staging VPC with audit logging + Datadog forwarding, run 48h smoke (5rps sustained), then controlled ramp. Infra asks: service account, CIDR, Okta metadata, and Datadog API key.

alexa.cs: Action owners and dates:
- alexa.cs: onboarding doc + customer contacts + runbook stub (due 2026-05-20)
- michael.eng: infra plan + capacity calc (due 2026-05-25)
- tom.support: create support access + attach compliance checklist (due 2026-05-18)
- mina.sales: provide sample prompts and security contact (due 2026-05-12)

mina.sales: Will send prompts and security contact today. Flagging renewal-watch in CRM.

alexa.cs: Adding quick triage template to HELIO-ONB-7111:
```
Customer: HelioThera (heliothera-prod)
Primary CS: alexa.cs
Primary Sales: mina.sales
Contacts: ops@heliothera.com, seclead@heliothera.com
Environment: Private VPC, hosted fallback
Requirements: GDPR/PII handling, Okta SSO, audit logging, per-route billing
Peak QPS: 15
Avg tokens: 70
Model preference: 13B-quantized (starter), target 70B
Known risks: compliance validation, onboarding timeline, renewal sensitivity
```

michael.eng: I'll attach the HIPAA/GDPR checklist link and propose a tech sync: Fri 2026-05-14 10:00 PT.

alexa.cs: Sync confirmed for Fri 2026-05-14 10:00 PT. Please update HELIO-ONB-7111 with owners and attach SOW + compliance docs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

mina.sales: Thanks team. :rocket:

tom.support: :white_check_mark:
